purpose: Classify every valid level-table entry and exit callback for native progression and replay planning.

callbacks.enter_effect: decrements LEVEL_TIMER and invokes 0x1B2650 when the one-shot timer expires
callbacks.exit_effect: sets transition selector 0x17, prepares common transition, writes VDP control 0x8B02

callbacks.enter_effect: arms SCENE_SCRIPT_COUNTDOWN=0xFF when PLAYER_WORLD_X>0x1287 and PLAYER_WORLD_Y<0x1D6, then decrements LEVEL_TIMER
callbacks.exit_effect: writes VDP control 0x8B02 and invokes common transition
sets camera/scroll flags, selects list pointer 0x2128 and transition selector 0x0F, prepares common transition
selects transition selector 0x10 and prepares common transition

callbacks.enter_effect: consumes one-shot flags and arms countdown 0xFF when FFF0E9==0, X>0x8D8 and Y<0x1EA
on a 0x40-frame cadence spawns template 0x1B819C in two coordinate regions
callbacks.exit_effect: invokes common transition, sets FFF111=1 and transition selector 0x18

callbacks.enter_effect: calls periodic helper and clears FFF0EB
callbacks.exit_effect: optionally spawns template 0x1B82F0, sets camera/scroll flags, selects list pointer 0x24FC and transition selector 0x0F

callbacks.enter_effect: arms countdown 0xFF when FFF0E9==0 and X>0x27C4, with periodic coordinate-window spawns
callbacks.exit_effect: writes VDP control 0x8B02 and invokes common transition

callbacks.enter_effect: advances FFF086/FFF088, consumes an event table through FFF12E and conditionally allocates camera-relative actors
callbacks.exit_effect: writes VDP control 0x8B02, selects list pointer 0x262F, captures player coordinates, selects animation 0x122350 and enables camera scroll

callbacks.enter_effect: periodically spawns template 0x1B7FA8 in X 0x6B0..0x9C8 and Y>0x19B; arms countdown 1 when X>0x1B9D
callbacks.exit_effect: writes VDP control 0x8B02, enables TERRAIN_SURFACE_MODE and invokes common transition

callbacks.enter_effect: arms countdown 1 when X>0xC49 and Y>0x495
callbacks.exit_effect: writes VDP control 0x8B02 and invokes common transition

callbacks.enter_effect: when timer is zero and X is 0x10..0x470 and Y is 0x130..0x1D0, spawns template 0x1B8214
callbacks.exit_effect: enters shared transition body after the VDP write and invokes common transition

callbacks.enter_effect: timer value 0x0D spawns template 0x1B7BE8; otherwise a cadence creates template 0x1B8278 with one of two animations
callbacks.exit_effect: creates three final-scene actors at fixed positions and does not invoke common transition

conclusion: All 13 valid level-table entries are now statically classified. Level 01 has a unique direct world-position countdown gate; later entries use distinct position, timer, event, and final-scene rules. The native runtime should consume this as level metadata rather than assume one generic exit path.
next_action: Promote the callback inventory into native level metadata and seed a replayable post-Level-01 resource checkpoint without treating the scene-3 transition loop as a playable next-level state.
